from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from datetime import date, time
from typing import Optional, List, Union

@dataclass
class ConversationSession:
    session_id: str
    date: date
    start_time: time
    notes: List[str] = field(default_factory=list)

@dataclass
class HealthStatus:
    person_name: str
    date_observed: date
    description: str
    is_scare: bool = False
    notes: List[str] = field(default_factory=list)

@dataclass
class DietaryPreference:
    person_name: str
    item: str
    is_healthy: bool
    is_weakness: bool = False
    is_substitution: bool = False
    notes: List[str] = field(default_factory=list)

@dataclass
class Trip:
    traveler_name: str
    destination: str
    start_date: Optional[date] = None
    end_date: Optional[date] = None
    participants: List[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    notes: List[str] = field(default_factory=list)

@dataclass
class Vehicle:
    owner: str
    make_model: str
    is_new: bool
    status: str  # e.g., "Owned", "Sold", "Repaired"
    notes: List[str] = field(default_factory=list)

@dataclass
class Hobby:
    practitioner: str
    activity: str
    start_year: Optional[int] = None
    passion_level: str = "Medium"
    notes: List[str] = field(default_factory=list)

@dataclass
class Book:
    reader: str
    title: str
    genre: str
    notes: List[str] = field(default_factory=list)
